about: Ashika Global Securities Ltd (AGSL; formerly Ashika Credit Capital Ltd) is the listed holding company of the Ashika financial services group and an RBI-registered, non-deposit- taking Middle Layer NBFC-ICC. Subsidiaries span broking/MTF, distribution, investment /merchant banking, AIFs and emerging wealth/insurance services. [1]
